Title: Architecture review gate C
Purpose: Stop after publication, runtime, and read-side work, then decide whether the module is truly moving toward smaller responsibilities and healthier behavior/projection boundaries.
Deliverables: Explicit pass/fail decision covering publication, runtime, and query direction.
Corrective subbundle if the gate fails.
ValidationCommands: Review execution-report rows, targeted test outputs, and the service split against the architecture docs.
ReviewQuestions: Are publication and clone responsibilities genuinely separated?
Is runtime logic now materially more testable and decomposed?
Did the read-side split reduce broad-load assumptions without creating shadow truth?
CorrectiveOnFailure: Create a gate-C corrective subbundle from `subbundles/_corrective-runtime-and-query-reset` or `subbundles/_corrective-template`, block the queue, and rerun gate C after the correction lands.
